descriptions.text: Enchanted Prison Tattoo Kit. So, you’re doing time. Hey, I’m not one to judge. You wonder, how did I get here? How did I mess my life up so much? You figure, now is the day I’m going to turn everything around. Now is the day I’m going to make certain I get on the right path. I’m gonna get out of here and get a job and make my family proud. Let me commemorate this important occasion by letting SkullFuck from the next cell come over and etch a poorly-drawn dragon on the side of my face. This kit allows an artist to create a tattoo of their choosing upon the skin of a willing or unwilling target. …

beats.headline: Stick and poke
beats.text: The Gold Quest Box for the Vengeance of the Daughter opens, and Carl recognises what comes out at once. Donut asks, with disgust, whether it is what she thinks. It is: a stick and poke tattoo kit, the same items Edgar the tortoise used to put magical tattoos on Tsarina Signet. A long, sharp needle, some ink, a few stick things, and something that looks like sandpaper. He has no idea how any of it works, and the description, about doing time, is no help. What is he supposed to do with this?

beats.headline: A pass on her neck
beats.text: At the Desperado's door, Clarabelle glares at Samantha: she has seen her on the recap plenty of times and never noticed the pass on her neck. Samantha hisses, snaps her teeth, and announces that she is going to kill Clarabelle's mother. Carl clamps her jaw shut with his arm and tells Clarabelle they just finished a quest where she killed someone, and they put the tattoo on her neck. It is disgusting, says Samantha, who hates tattoos more than she hates sushi. A gold coin, and Clarabelle waves them through.

beats.headline: The ink is fading
beats.text: Carl picks Samantha up in both hands and looks her in the eyes. She is covered in sand and gore, heavier than usual, with a slight vibration to her. The Desperado Club logo is still on her neck, where Katia tapped it with the poke and stick tattoo kit, but the ink is starting to fade. This is important, he tells her, so pay attention.

beats.headline: Through Carl's hands
beats.text: Combined with Shi Maria, Carl is a torso on a spider's body, and she is in control. She pulls the stick and poke kit from his inventory into his hands. When Li Jun slides down Li Na's chain to help, she has warned him: Carl jabs the stick into Li Jun's eye, licks the eye off and eats it. If he will not take her card to the next floor, she tells him, she will attach herself to something he cannot discard so easily. She dips the stick into the beaker and rapidly pokes a small tattoo into his bare chest, just above the sternum: an eye, which blinks, closes and disappears against his skin.

beats.headline: The right sleeve
beats.text: Katia sets a vial of ready-mixed ink on the table, and Carl puts the poke and stick kit beside it. Li Na is not mad at him, Katia says, only at herself for not protecting her brother. Her blood was freely given, so she lost five levels only for a while and can still use the skill; the tattoo itself is permanent. Carl has several tattoos on his left arm and none on his right, so the right sleeve it is. A level-13 skill needs a big one and almost all the ink. Rosetta says a properly themed tattoo lasts longer.
